title: Haan tunjo matam
body:
Haan tunjo matam
Munjo marshid maula sayi, Maula sayi, Ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Nabiyal jee ibadat aa matam, (Momin jee shifa'at aa matam) x2 kar gham bhar ke salmaan
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu ayaa huwe ibne haider, (sehwar jagir ali akber) x2 momin jee wadae shaam
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ki dua tera matam, (har gham ki dua tera matam) x2 bakshish ka banaa samaan
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
jab yaad aaye phat ta hai jigar (wo shaame ghariban ka manzar) x2 karte the haram yakjaan
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Din raat bhi matam karte hai (aur chand sitare rote hai) x2 karta hai falak har aah
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
the ahle haram paband rasn, (karti thi buka har gham behen) x2 barpa tha sare zindan
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
lashe pe tere sab rote the, (barpa maktal me karte the) x2 ho teero tabar paikaan
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi ke lahu me duba alam (aur zere alam sab ehle haram) x2 karte the baka har aan
<<MINI>>
(haan tunjo matam maula sayi) x2 ay momin-e jee pehchaan
